name: app-onboarding-travel-app-magenta-yellow-illustration
title: Magenta/yellow travel app onboarding with phone mockup
whatItIs: A phone mockup showing a travel-itinerary UI screen beside three flat-illustrated onboarding cards (travel assistant, beach & cocktail, currency exchange) in a magenta/yellow palette with pill-shaped buttons.
whatItMeans: Pairing one real functional UI screen with several illustrated pitch cards lets the design sell both 'what the app does' (illustration) and 'what it looks like' (real screen) in one image.
techniques: show one functioning UI screen alongside several illustrated benefit cards side by side
alternate card background colors (blue/yellow) across an onboarding set to signal distinct steps
use pill-shaped buttons consistently to unify CTAs across illustrated and real UI screens

vocabulary.definition: a single onboarding screen designed to sell one specific feature or benefit before the user reaches the main app
